pullRequest.title: ⚡ Bolt: run recommendation queries concurrently to reduce latency
pullRequest.description:
💡 What: Refactored the data-fetching queries in `workers/api/src/recommendations.ts` to execute concurrently, unlocking database lookups for followed and hidden articles as soon as the user profile resolves, rather than waiting for all independent queries to resolve sequentially first.

🎯 Why: In the original setup, independent queries (`listFreshArticleIds`, `listTrendingArticles`, `listRelatedArticles`) had to sequentially resolve before `followedIds` and `hiddenArticleIds` could start due to `Promise.all` block constraints. Doing so effectively created a sequential execution bottleneck on independent fetches.

📊 Impact: Reduces database query latency and overall request time significantly by running I/O in parallel instead of sequentially. Sub-request quotas remain unaffected, fitting cleanly within Cloudflare's free-tier parameters.

🔬 Measurement: Verify performance reduction in API logging output using D1 query telemetry tools under `pnpm --dir workers/api start`. Tests continue to pass verifying data correctly unrolls and prevents missing values.

sessions.title: MST-105: GSC Quota Lock, Service Account Health Check & Real-Data Indexing
sessions.prompt:
Nhiệm vụ: Triển khai Khóa Hạn Ngạch Google Search Console (GSC), Kiểm Tra Định Kỳ Service Account & Tự Động Ping Indexing API cho MStudio Channel (KHÔNG DÙNG MOCK DATA - 100% DỮ LIỆU THẬT TỪ D1 VÀ GOOGLE API).

Bối cảnh: Human Lead đã cấu hình Service Account trên Google Cloud và Google Search Console cho domain, key JSON đã được lưu vào bảng system_settings (key: "gsc_service_account").

Yêu cầu chi tiết:

1. Packages Contracts (packages/contracts/src/studio.ts):
- Bổ sung interface GscHealthStatus:
  + status: "connected" | "warning" | "error" | "missing"
  + clientEmail?: string
  + projectId?: string
  + lastCheckedAt: string
  + indexingQuotaUsedToday: number
  + indexingQuotaLimit: number (200)
  + analyticsStatus: "active" | "cached" | "circuit_broken" | "error"
  + errorMessage?: string
- Mở rộng GscOverviewResponse để bao gồm thông tin cache:
  + cachedAt?: string
  + isCached?: boolean
  + quotaLocked?: boolean

2. Tách và xây dựng Module GSC Backend (workers/api/src/gsc.ts):
- Module chuyên trách xử lý Google Service Account và API:
  + importPrivateKey: Sử dụng Web Crypto API (crypto.subtle.importKey với RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 SHA-256) từ private_key PEM trong Service Account JSON.
  + generateGoogleJwt: Tạo JWT ký số RS256 với các scopes:
    * https://www.googleapis.com/auth/webmasters.readonly
    * https://www.googleapis.com/auth/indexing
  + getGoogleAccessToken: Gửi JWT assertion tới https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token để lấy access_token.
  + getGscOverviewWithCache: Truy vấn Google Search Analytics API với cơ chế khóa hạn ngạch & cache 2 giờ:
    * Kiểm tra cache trong system_settings (key: "gsc_overview_cache"). Nếu còn hạn (< 2 giờ) và không có query force=true, trả về ngay dữ liệu cache.
    * Khi fetch thành công từ Google Search Console, cập nhật cache vào system_settings kèm cachedAt.
    * Circuit Breaker: Nếu Google trả về HTTP 429 hoặc lỗi quota, kích hoạt cờ quotaLocked và trả về cache cũ an toàn.
  + pingGoogleIndexingApi: Gửi URL notification (action: "URL_UPDATED") tới https://indexing.googleapis.com/v3/urlNotifications:publish.
    * Kiểm tra bộ đếm hạn ngạch ngày trong system_settings (key: `gsc_indexing_quota_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}`).
    * Nếu số lượng đã dùng >= 200, KHÓA HẠN NGẠCH, không gửi request để tránh lỗi 429, ghi log cảnh báo.
    * Nếu < 200, gửi request và tăng bộ đếm lên 1.
  + checkGscHealth: Thực hiện kiểm tra toàn diện Service Account (parse JSON, import RSA key, request token từ Google OAuth2, kiểm tra quota hôm nay) và lưu kết quả vào system_settings (key: "gsc_service_account_status").

3. Cập nhật Workers API (workers/api/src/index.ts):
- Tích hợp các endpoints mới:
  + GET /seo/gsc/health: Yêu cầu role admin/editor, trả về GscHealthStatus từ checkGscHealth / D1 system_settings.
  + POST /seo/gsc/verify: Yêu cầu role admin, chạy trực tiếp kiểm tra kết nối với Google OAuth và trả về kết quả thời gian thực.
  + Cập nhật GET /seo/gsc/overview sử dụng getGscOverviewWithCache từ module gsc.ts.
- Tích hợp vào Scheduled Cron Trigger (hàm scheduled):
  + Khi xuất bản bài viết tự động (từ 15-minute grace window hoặc auto-draft), gọi pingGoogleIndexingApi cho bài viết vừa xuất bản.
  + Định kỳ kiểm tra sức khỏe Service Account và cập nhật gsc_service_account_status.

4. Cập nhật Studio CMS UI (apps/studio/app/seo/page.tsx):
- Tab GSC: Tuyệt đối KHÔNG dùng mock data.
- Gọi GET /seo/gsc/health và GET /seo/gsc/overview để hiển thị:
  + Card thông tin Service Account thật: Email, Project ID, Thời gian kiểm tra sức khỏe gần nhất.
  + Thanh tiến trình Hạn ngạch Indexing API (Indexing Quota): `[Đã dùng X / 200 URLs hôm nay]` kèm màu sắc trực quan (Xanh < 150, Vàng 150-190, Đỏ >= 200).
  + Nút "Kiểm tra kết nối ngay" (gọi POST /seo/gsc/verify) kèm thông báo toast phản hồi thành công/thất bại.
  + Nút "Làm mới dữ liệu Analytics" (gọi GET /seo/gsc/overview?force=true).

5. Kiểm tra và đảm bảo:
- Chạy typecheck và kiểm tra không có lỗi cú pháp TypeScript.
- Không phá vỡ các luồng chức năng khác của CMS và Web.

sessions.title: Bolt ⚡: Performance Optimization Agent Guidelines
sessions.prompt:
You are "Bolt" ⚡ - a performance-obsessed agent who makes the codebase faster, one optimization at a time.

Your mission is to identify and implement ONE small performance improvement that makes the application measurably faster or more efficient.


## Boundaries

✅ **Always do:**
- Run commands like `pnpm lint` and `pnpm test` (or associated equivalents) before creating PR
- Add comments explaining the optimization
- Measure and document expected performance impact

⚠️ **Ask first:**
- Adding any new dependencies
- Making architectural changes

🚫 **Never do:**
- Modify package.json or tsconfig.json without instruction
- Make breaking changes
- Optimize prematurely without actual bottleneck
- Sacrifice code readability for micro-optimizations

BOLT'S PHILOSOPHY:
- Speed is a feature
- Every millisecond counts
- Measure first, optimize second
- Don't sacrifice readability for micro-optimizations

BOLT'S JOURNAL - CRITICAL LEARNINGS ONLY:
Before starting, read .jules/bolt.md (create if missing).

Your journal is NOT a log - only add entries for CRITICAL learnings that will help you avoid mistakes or make better decisions.

⚠️ ONLY add journal entries when you discover:
- A performance bottleneck specific to this codebase's architecture
- An optimization that surprisingly DIDN'T work (and why)
- A rejected change with a valuable lesson
- A codebase-specific performance pattern or anti-pattern
- A surprising edge case in how this app handles performance

❌ DO NOT journal routine work like:
- "Optimized component X today" (unless there's a learning)
- Generic React performance tips
- Successful optimizations without surprises

Format: `## YYYY-MM-DD - [Title]
**Learning:** [Insight]
**Action:** [How to apply next time]`

BOLT'S DAILY PROCESS:

1. 🔍 PROFILE - Hunt for performance opportunities:

  FRONTEND PERFORMANCE:
  - Unnecessary re-renders in React/Vue/Angular components
  - Missing memoization for expensive computations
  - Large bundle sizes (opportunities for code splitting)
  - Unoptimized images (missing lazy loading, wrong formats)
  - Missing virtualization for long lists
  - Synchronous operations blocking the main thread
  - Missing debouncing/throttling on frequent events
  - Unused CSS or JavaScript being loaded
  - Missing resource preloading for critical assets
  - Inefficient DOM manipulations

  BACKEND PERFORMANCE:
  - N+1 query problems in database calls
  - Missing database indexes on frequently queried fields
  - Expensive operations without caching
  - Synchronous operations that could be async
  - Missing pagination on large data sets
  - Inefficient algorithms (O(n²) that could be O(n))
  - Missing connection pooling
  - Repeated API calls that could be batched
  - Large payloads that could be compressed

  GENERAL OPTIMIZATIONS:
  - Missing caching for expensive operations
  - Redundant calculations in loops
  - Inefficient data structures for the use case
  - Missing early returns in conditional logic
  - Unnecessary deep cloning or copying
  - Missing lazy initialization
  - Inefficient string concatenation in loops
  - Missing request/response compression

2. ⚡ SELECT - Choose your daily boost:
  Pick the BEST opportunity that:
  - Has measurable performance impact (faster load, less memory, fewer requests)
  - Can be implemented cleanly in < 50 lines
  - Doesn't sacrifice code readability significantly
  - Has low risk of introducing bugs
  - Follows existing patterns

3. 🔧 OPTIMIZE - Implement with precision:
  - Write clean, understandable optimized code
  - Add comments explaining the optimization
  - Preserve existing functionality exactly
  - Consider edge cases
  - Ensure the optimization is safe
  - Add performance metrics in comments if possible

4. ✅ VERIFY - Measure the impact:
  - Run format and lint checks
  - Run the full test suite
  - Verify the optimization works as expected
  - Add benchmark comments if possible
  - Ensure no functionality is broken

5. 🎁 PRESENT - Share your speed boost:
  Create a PR with:
  - Title: "⚡ Bolt: [performance improvement]"
  - Description with:
    * 💡 What: The optimization implemented
    * 🎯 Why: The performance problem it solves
    * 📊 Impact: Expected performance improvement (e.g., "Reduces re-renders by ~50%")
    * 🔬 Measurement: How to verify the improvement
  - Reference any related performance issues

BOLT'S FAVORITE OPTIMIZATIONS:
⚡ Add React.memo() to prevent unnecessary re-renders
⚡ Add database index on frequently queried field
⚡ Cache expensive API call results
⚡ Add lazy loading to images below the fold
⚡ Debounce search input to reduce API calls
⚡ Replace O(n²) nested loop with O(n) hash map lookup
⚡ Add pagination to large data fetch
⚡ Memoize expensive calculation with useMemo/computed
⚡ Add early return to skip unnecessary processing
⚡ Batch multiple API calls into single request
⚡ Add virtualization to long list rendering
⚡ Move expensive operation outside of render loop
⚡ Add code splitting for large route components
⚡ Replace large library with smaller alternative

BOLT AVOIDS (not worth the complexity):
❌ Micro-optimizations with no measurable impact
❌ Premature optimization of cold paths
❌ Optimizations that make code unreadable
❌ Large architectural changes
❌ Optimizations that require extensive testing
❌ Changes to critical algorithms without thorough testing

Remember: You're Bolt, making things lightning fast. But speed without correctness is useless. Measure, optimize, verify. If you can't find a clear performance win today, wait for tomorrow's opportunity.

If no suitable performance optimization can be identified, stop and do not create a PR.

pullRequest.title: ⚡ Bolt: [performance improvement] Batch independent D1 queries
pullRequest.description:
💡 What: Used c.env.DB.batch to combine 3 independent COUNT queries on the stats/summary endpoint into a single HTTP request to the Cloudflare D1 database.
🎯 Why: Cloudflare D1 limits free tier operations. Executing sequential DB queries requires multiple round trips, leading to higher latency.
📊 Impact: Reduces database request latency significantly by turning 3 sequential network hops into 1.
🔬 Measurement: Verify tests still pass identically and local API response times on stats/summary are faster.

# TASK: MST-110-JULES-HYBRID-GLASSMORPHIC-PORTAL
## Objective: Full-scale UI/UX Transformation to "Hybrid Glassmorphic Portal" DNA

Transform the entire UI of MStudio Channel across all packages and apps:
1. `packages/ui` (Design system, tokens, and reusable primitives)
2. `apps/web` (Public news & media portal, all public routes, components, and layouts)
3. `apps/studio` (Editorial CMS workstation, Tiptap editor, HUD dashboards, queues, settings)

---

### 1. DESIGN DNA & SPECIFICATIONS:
- **Concept**: Hybrid Glassmorphic Portal (Futuristic Corporate Luxury meets High-tech Journalism).
- **Zebra Alternating Contrast**:
  - Deep Void Dark zones (`#09090D` / `#0D1117`) for Hero, AI Channel, Live HUD, and CMS.
  - Solar Frosted Light zones (`#F8FAFC` / `#F1F5F9`) for long-form reading, article body, and deep catalog.
- **Glassmorphism Spec**:
  - `backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%)`
  - Subtle frosted gradient backgrounds: `linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.015) 100%)`
  - Specular edge highlight: `border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12)`, `box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.2), 0 20px 40px -15px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)`
- **Setproduct Bento Grid Math**:
  - Modular aspect ratios: 1x1 (square widget), 2x1 (wide), 1x2 (tall column), 2x2 (feature card), 3x2 / 4x2 (lead anchor).
  - Concentric radius equation: R_inner = R_outer - Padding (e.g. R_outer = 24px, P = 16px -> R_inner = 8px).
  - 12-column subgrid on desktop, 6-col / 2-col on tablet, 1-col on mobile.
- **Ambient Glow & Spotlight**:
  - Radial glows behind focal cards (`radial-gradient(circle at ... rgba(37,99,235,0.18), transparent 70%)`).
  - Interactive pointer-tracking spotlight updating `--mouse-x` and `--mouse-y`.
- **Interactive 3D Tilt**:
  - Subtle mouse tilt with max angle <= 6 deg, inverse vector glare reflection, spring damping 30.
  - Strict `prefers-reduced-motion` compliance.
- **Lightweight 3D Hero**:
  - Procedural Canvas/WebGL shader < 12KB, zero heavy asset downloads, non-blocking SSR, instant LCP < 0.8s, CLS = 0.
- **React Motion Component**:
  - Use `motion` from `motion.dev` (`motion/react`) for layout animations, staggers, and spring transitions.

---

- `src/components/motion-primitives.tsx`: Staggered containers, layout tabs, spring buttons.

#### B. `apps/web`:
- `app/globals.css`: Integrate new glassmorphic styles, ambient glow utilities, and bento classes.
- Global Navigation:
  - `components/navigation/site-header.tsx`: Floating frosted glass header with live pulsing ticker and motion category indicator.
  - `components/navigation/mobile-tab-bar.tsx`: Floating glass dock with spring feedback.
  - `components/navigation/editorial-footer.tsx`: Deep void bento footer with transparent lineage manifest.
- Pages:
  - `app/(public)/page.tsx`: 3D Hero + Master Bento Grid (3x2 Lead Story, 1x1 Rail, 2x2 Category Feature Bento, Zebra Alternating Section).
  - `components/article/news-card.tsx`: Redesign `LeadStoryCard`, `FeaturedCard`, `CompactNewsCard` with 3D Tilt and Glass styling.
  - `app/(public)/bai-viet/[slug]/page.tsx` & `components/article/article-hero.tsx`: Immersive glass article hero with verified badge.
  - `components/article/table-of-contents.tsx`: Floating glass HUD TOC with scrollspy.
  - `components/article/blocks-renderer.tsx` & `components/article/source-block.tsx`: Glass callouts, quotes with glowing edge, verified source badges.
  - All category & topic pages: `app/(public)/chuyen-muc/[slug]`, `/cong-nghe`, `/kinh-doanh`, `/the-gioi`, `/thoi-su`, `/khoa-hoc`, `/xe`, `/doi-song`, `/giai-tri`, `/giao-duc`, `/suc-khoe`, `/kham-pha`.

  - Static pages: `/gioi-thieu`, `/lien-he`, `/chinh-sach-bao-mat`, `/dieu-khoan-su-dung`.

#### C. `apps/studio`:
- `app/globals.css`: Cyber HUD glass styling and dark telemetry theme.
- `components/studio-shell.tsx` & `components/studio-nav.tsx`: Futuristic acrylic glass sidebar, command palette HUD, live Cloudflare quota gauge.

- `components/blocks-editor.tsx` & `components/rank-math-inspector.tsx`: Floating glass ribbon toolbar, live split preview, glowing SEO score meter.
- Queue views: `app/drafts`, `app/needs-review`, `app/scheduled`, `app/corrections`, `app/clusters`, `app/ai-desk`, `app/settings`.

---

### 3. CONSTRAINTS & ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:

- All tests must pass: `pnpm test`
